items.q: I got, uh, Chris Kelly, Ramona. I played at, uh, Ramona.

ctx.x: So anyway, that was the first thing I wanted to ask you about, was about change of name, you know, Zeno, and when you changed it and why. Well, when I was born, my mother had several names, Francis, Joseph, Louis, Zeno. George was nowhere around. My mother had all the children that my mother had, two before me, they died. So my grandmother said, call this one George. My mother never had in her mind to call me George. But my grandma kept calling me George until my christening time when my mother went and had me…

items.q: The interviewee mentions Chris Kelly's funeral and that 'they all knew one area', but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Chris Kelly himself.

ctx.x: Well, I wouldn't, I wouldn't count on that either because, you know, he might not remember. items.q: I went up with Chris Kelly... We had Thomas and Chris Kelly.

Oh, well, I did. Ruffin's, I remember mentioning that this, that this, poor man, poor man, not poor man, he's an ordinary poor, uh, Ruffins.
